scripts.dev:web: sh -ac 'if [ "$PORTLESS" != "0" ]; then . ./.env.portless; fi; exec portless run --name tito bun run --cwd apps/web dev'
scripts.dev:api: sh -ac 'if [ "$PORTLESS" != "0" ]; then . ./.env.portless; fi; exec portless run --name api.tito bun run --cwd apps/api dev'
scripts.dev:emails: sh -ac 'if [ "$PORTLESS" != "0" ]; then . ./.env.portless; fi; exec portless run --name emails.tito bun run --cwd apps/api email:dev'
scripts.generate:api: bun run --cwd apps/api openapi && orval --config orval.config.ts
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/api build
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run format:check
